_comment: Localized Desktop Entry keys for W's own applications. Key = '<desktop file basename>.<Entry key>'. The 'en' value MUST equal the unlocalized key in the .desktop file — per the freedesktop spec that line IS the C/English value, so w-i18n-gen asserts they match instead of writing it twice. Every other language becomes a 'Key[lang]=' line. Keywords keep the Latin terms alongside the translated ones: a user searching the launcher may type either.
